data.title: Crypto Off-Ramp After Wire or ACH Receipt
data.description: Detects a pattern where an account receives a wire or ACH credit and then promptly initiates a transfer to a known cryptocurrency exchange or digital asset platform. Converting fraud proceeds to cryptocurrency provides near-irreversible laundering, making this a critical monetization indicator.

queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Crypto Off-Ramp After Wire or ACH Receipt")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection_inbound | near selection_crypto_outbound by account_id")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:transaction_monitoring
(event_type="WIRE_CREDIT" OR event_type="ACH_CREDIT")
transaction_amount>=1000
(event_type="WIRE_INITIATION" OR event_type="ACH_DEBIT")
beneficiary_category="crypto_exchange"
(beneficiary_name="Coinbase" OR beneficiary_name="Binance" OR beneficiary_name="Kraken" OR beneficiary_name="FTX" OR beneficiary_name="Gemini")
| transaction account_id maxspan=24h
| where eventcount >= 2

falsepositives: Legitimate cryptocurrency investors or traders funding exchange accounts from bank proceeds
Businesses with crypto treasury strategies converting fiat after receivables
